Repo: Tendril (current directory). Contest: tagging. Main files are likely shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/tendril/app/data/page/Label.kt, LabelDao.kt, PageRelation.kt, domain/LabelMembership.kt, and the sync mappers (sync/PagesSyncEngine.kt, SnapshotMappers.kt).
Claims from the map:
1. Label stores a name and a colour, and PageLabel joins labels to pages. List every column of both with its type and nullability.
Claims about behaviour (verify each; quote the rule):
2. Labels can be applied to anything other than pages (entries, tasks, habits, blocks); grep for every table that references a label id and report zero hits if none.
3. Label names are unique (constraint or code), case-sensitive or not.
4. A label can be renamed, recoloured and deleted; deleting it removes it from pages or is blocked.
5. Labels nest (a parent id) or not.
6. Where labels are used to filter or group (screens, search, calendar).
7. How Label and PageLabel rows sync (tombstoned, delete-wins, last-writer-wins).

Repo: Chronicle (current directory). Contest: tagging. Main files are likely data/src/main/kotlin/com/hazia/chronicle/data/room/entity/CategoryEntity.kt, TrackerEntity.kt, ActivityEntity.kt, dao/CoreDao.kt, EntityMappers.kt, and the category screens.
Claims from the map:
1. CategoryEntity stores a name and a colour; categories can be renamed, recoloured and deleted. List every column with its type and nullability.
Claims about behaviour (verify each; quote the rule):
2. What a category is applied to (trackers, activities, reminders, entries); list every table with a category id, and say whether it is one category per row or many.
3. Category names are unique, case-sensitive or not.
4. Deleting a category: what happens to the rows that carry it (null, reassigned, blocked, cascaded).
5. Categories nest (a parent id) or have an order.
6. Where categories are used to filter, group or colour (screens, charts).
7. How CategoryEntity rows sync (per-field stamps, tombstones).
